the_vole_dispute.name: The Vole Dispute
the_vole_dispute.description: Win your first fight. The vole was never up for discussion.

seasoned_prowler.name: Seasoned Prowler
seasoned_prowler.description: Win fifty fights. The alleys are starting to tell stories about you.

first_visit_complimentary.name: First Visit Complimentary
first_visit_complimentary.description: Spend a life. The Hollow Court validates parking.

regular_customer.name: Regular Customer
regular_customer.description: Spend nine lives. The Clerk keeps your form at the front of the drawer now.

the_meeting_was_declined.name: The Meeting Was Declined
the_meeting_was_declined.description: Slip away from a fight. A cat does not lose fights; it schedules them for never.

strategic_withdrawal_expert.name: Nine-Tenths of Valor
strategic_withdrawal_expert.description: Slip away twenty times. Discretion is a skill. You are gifted.

not_a_whisker.name: Not a Whisker Misplaced
not_a_whisker.description: Win a fight without taking any damage.

running_on_fumes.name: Running on Fumes
running_on_fumes.description: Win a fight with your energy deck completely empty. Spite is also a resource.

it_was_already_broken.name: It Was Already Broken
it_was_already_broken.description: Finish an enemy with Shelf Justice. Gravity did most of the work. You did the important part.

dignity_optional.name: Dignity Optional
dignity_optional.description: Win a fight using nothing but Scratch. Rarely sufficient. Apparently sufficient.

audible_next_room.name: Audible From the Next Room
audible_next_room.description: Finish a full purr without being interrupted. Self-care is a discipline.

pest_control.name: Pest Control
pest_control.description: Defeat ten gutter-wisps. The gutters file a formal complaint.

territory_dispute_resolved.name: Territory Dispute: Resolved
territory_dispute_resolved.description: Defeat the dog. The chain was never the problem.

robbed_in_broad_daylight.name: Robbed in Broad Daylight
robbed_in_broad_daylight.description: Lose twenty cards to enemies attacking your hand. Hold things closer.

big_spender.name: Big Spender
big_spender.description: Spend two hundred energy cards. Wind and nerve, freely given.

nine_minus_one.name: Nine Minus One
nine_minus_one.description: Stood between the Unpicked and her chair, and paid for it.

unpicked_unpicked.name: The Unpicked, Unpicked
unpicked_unpicked.description: Defeat the Unpicked. This was not supposed to be possible. The Clerk has questions.

gainful_employment.name: Gainful Employment
gainful_employment.description: Complete a quest from the Mantel. She would have called this 'finally contributing'.

curiosity_paid_out.name: Curiosity, Paid Out
curiosity_paid_out.description: Press on five times instead of slipping away. Satisfaction pending.

dragonish.name: Dragonish
dragonish.description: Bank 150 gleam lifetime. The Magpie Exchange sends a fruit basket.

nothing_woke.name: Nothing Woke
nothing_woke.description: Clear a stealth encounter without raising the alarm. The dahlias never knew.

above_the_law.name: Above the Law
above_the_law.description: Defeat the Captain of the Watch. The chain of office was ceremonial after all.
